_readme: Trades are hand-edited ideas + script-evaluated status. SLATE model: up to one active idea per coin (max 5), listed in slate.coins[coin] = {trade_id | null, note}. Fields: id, coin, direction long|short, leverage (3 default), entry (planned; replaced by fill price when filled, original kept in planned_entry), entry_zone {low, high} (optional), stop, targets[], opened_at, expiry (fill deadline for pending; legacy fill_by also accepted), expires (optional max hold for open trades), status pending|open|won|lost|stopped|cancelled, missed_it {max_entry, note}, reasoning. Script fills targets_hit/filled_at/closed_at/exit_price/pnl_pct/unrealized_pnl_pct/mark_price. Times are ISO-8601; no offset = US Central.

trades.reasoning: Seed trade: XRP long from the 1.33 area with a stop under 1.28 and targets at 1.40 / 1.42. (Opening time assumed to be the start of Oct 16, 2026 Central since no exact time was given.)

SEED IDEA. Don't chase XRP at $1.38 into 1.42 resistance; instead bid a pullback to $1.35 (today's breakout/consolidation zone above the 1.33 pivot). Stop $1.305 sits under RoboForex's H4 support (1.309) and the Oct 19–20 range, so the idea is invalidated if the bounce fails. T1 $1.42 = H4/7-day resistance; T2 $1.47 = bull-case projection. Risk −3.3% (−10.0% at 3x) vs. +5.2% / +8.9% (+15.6% / +26.7% at 3x). [Originally posted at 5x; changed to 3x on Oct 21.] Limit order: cancels if not filled by Oct 23 11:05 AM CT. Risks: BTC losing $82.5K, Fed Oct 27–28. Entry zone 1.345–1.355 added Oct 21 for the slate model (centered on the original 1.35 limit, ≈ the 1h EMA20).

trades.reasoning: SWING / RANGE trade (multi-day). AXL has been range-trading in a channel since Sep 22 (Coinbase daily + 4H candles): outer floor 0.0475-0.0505 (6 swing lows: 0.0488 Sep 24, 0.0501 Sep 29, 0.0493 Oct 1, 0.0505 Oct 2, 0.0490 Oct 7, 0.0475 Oct 8; only three 4H closes under 0.050, reclaimed within a day), a rising inner shelf at 0.0516-0.0535 (6 lows since Oct 13: 0.0533, 0.0516, 0.0535, 0.0532, 0.0528, 0.0525) and a ceiling at 0.0600-0.0647 (4 rejections: 0.0600 Sep 27, 0.0629 Oct 12, 0.0647 Oct 14, 0.0642 Oct 18; highest 4H close 0.0621, no daily close above 0.0603). Floor-to-ceiling legs have run +21-32% and ceiling-to-floor drops -15-20%, usually in 1-4 days. Price (~0.0545) sits just above the shelf, below mid-channel (~0.056), so this is a pending limit at the shelf, not a chase. Stop 0.0505 is under the 0.0516 shelf low: a break there means the October floor failed and price likely rotates to 0.0475-0.050 (a stop under 0.0475 from a 0.053 fill would risk about 35% of margin at 3x for a sub-1.5 R:R to T2). T1 0.0583 sits under the 0.0581-0.0591 lower-high cluster; T2 0.0620 sits under the 0.0625-0.0647 rejection wicks. R:R from the worst fill (0.0530): 2.1 to T1, 3.6 to T2. Signals: 1h Buy, 1d Buy (above EMA50/EMA200, daily StochRSI oversold), 4h Sell (below EMA20/50), so wait for the floor. Context: CoinDCX (Oct 15) reports the Oct 14 spike came with no Axelar announcement, on volume equal to 78% of market cap, and warns of sharp retracements once volume normalizes. That fits wick-and-fade range behaviour more than a breakout. Mirror trade: after T2, a rejection at 0.0615-0.0645 is the short back toward the shelf.

trades.reasoning: SPOT POSITION idea (1x, long only; a long-term spot holding idea, and the main perp venues used here (Bitunix, Binance, OKX, Kraken Futures, Coinbase) list no XDC perpetual). Kraken candles: today's +11% move broke the Oct 15-20 lower highs (0.0352 to 0.0329) and is testing the 0.0355-0.0360 ceiling (Oct 9/10/12 highs 0.03587/0.03574/0.03569, today 0.03597), but it has not closed a 4H or daily candle above 0.0360. Volume is higher (Kraken ~1.6x its 10-day average, CoinGecko all-exchange ~$25.6M vs ~$8-18M/day) on the SBI/Shinhan yen-stablecoin MOU and this week's MoneyGram validator news. Price is stretched (4H above the upper Bollinger band, 1h RSI 80), so this is a pending buy on a retest of 0.0347-0.0352: the broken lower-high line (Oct 15 high 0.0352, Oct 16 0.0347) and today's 1-3 PM CT base (1h lows 0.0347-0.0350). Stop 0.0330 sits under today's 7 AM CT 4H low (0.0339) and the Oct 13 low (0.03318), near the daily EMA20 (0.0334). A close there means the breakout failed and the October floor (0.0318-0.0321) is in play. T1 0.0383 is under the Sep 29 high (0.0384, the 90-day high); T2 0.0440 is under the Jan 22-23 highs. R:R from the worst fill (0.0352): 1.4 to T1, 4.0 to T2, about 2.7 blended (equal halves; the stop moves to breakeven after T1). P&L is at 1x: T1 +8.8%, T2 +25%, stop -6.3% from 0.0352. The news is mostly MOUs and pilots with no disclosed numbers, so the idea rests on the levels, not on the headlines.
